win_chance: nflverse win chance (adjusted for pregame expectations) for the scoring team at the try; regulation only

per_choice_win_chance.method: fourth_down_engine.v3 win-chance model; expected win chance after each outcome (made / missed), opponent then receives a touchback kickoff; regulation only
per_choice_win_chance.kick_rate_source: engine field-goal make rate at 33 yd (PAT)
per_choice_win_chance.null_reason: overtime tries have no win chance; Q4 tries with 0:01-2:00 left are null: the engine's win-chance model misreads the final minutes (e.g. up 1, TD at 0:02, kick read 0.67 vs ~0.97) and its drive-outcome blending only covers drives starting inside the 40, not a kickoff at the 25
